experiment: detection accuracy and throughput on synthetic labeled corpora
matching: type-aware, predicted span counts as a hit if it overlaps >=50% of the gold span

runs.caveat: The clean corpus is a REGRESSION FIXTURE, not a real-world accuracy measure: gold positives use the same canonical formats the detector targets, so recall is near-circular. Quote evaluate.py against an independent corpus for a defensible accuracy number.

runs.command: python benchmarks/generate_hard_dataset.py --size-mb 5 --out benchmarks/data_hard && python benchmarks/run_benchmark.py --data benchmarks/data_hard
runs.note: Adversarial corpus embeds real PII in noisy log/JSON/CSV/SQL dense with hard negatives (Luhn-failing 16-digit numbers, 5-octet IPs, invalid SSNs, UUIDs). This precision-under-distractors number is the genuinely informative signal: 45 false positives across 70,169 gold entities.

presidio: not benchmarked in this environment (presidio-analyzer not installed; run_benchmark.py runs it automatically when the [bench] extra is present)
